result.note: Rebuilt pkg-node for G15 (proposals/Agent_Frame_Tool_Allowlist_v1.md): an omitted allowed_tools in @frame_declaration now parses to ["*"] (every tool), a written [] stays empty (no tool), and a written value that is not a list parses to [] (fails closed). Two release builds, the second in a fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR, produced the same digest. Only holoscript_wasm_bg.wasm changed; the generated .js and .d.ts are byte-identical to the previous artifact and pkg-node/package.json was kept. rustc 1.91.0. The previous artifact (481,843 bytes) was built with rustc 1.98.1, which is not on this machine: the unchanged parent source (abfdbf543) built here with rustc 1.91.0 is 527,786 bytes (sha256 135a723c04f92e511e832391a7582a7b17817dbf1c58f764b2062aaef1a36691), so this change adds 111 bytes and the rest of the difference is the toolchain. The browser build in pkg/ was not rebuilt. No version bump.
